list_services.description: Every service in the federation with its repo, paths, endpoint count and consumer counts. Works on `live` and named snapshots (§12).

inputSchema.description: Input for `list_services`. On `live` only — PR 16 scope; PR 11/13 will route the value through the snapshot manager.

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor (base64url of `{v:1, after, q}`). Reused with different args → `cursor_mismatch`.

repo.description: Optional: pin the listing to one repo (every listed service must live there)

snapshot.description: Snapshot id (`live` for the in-process view; PR 11 surfaces named snapshots)

inputSchema.title: list_services input

get_service.description: Consumers of one service: endpoints, calling code, fields used, and the `used_by` walk that explains why each caller runs (§10.9).

inputSchema.description: Input for `get_service`. Live only — PR 11/13 surfaces named snapshots.

depth.description: Max depth for the `used_by` walk (§10.9). Default 4, max 8.

inputSchema.title: get_service input

prepare_snapshot.description: Pin every repo to a commit, index once, reuse the result. Same inputs after ref resolution produce the same id (§8.4); `from` derives a snapshot from an existing base (§11).

inputSchema.description: Input for `prepare_snapshot`. Same inputs after ref resolution produce the same snapshot id (§8.4) — `prepare_snapshot` is idempotent.

exclude.description: Repos to exclude from the snapshot (§8.4).

from.description: Snapshot id to derive from (§11). Derived snapshots inherit `join_config` and the un-overridden commits; they do NOT inherit failure. Mutually exclusive with `max_base_age_s`.

max_base_age_s.description: Reuse the newest `ready` record younger than this age for any repo not in `repos`. Only valid without `from` (§11).

repos.description: `repo -> ref | sha` map. Refs resolved against the federation's mirror; shas passed through unchanged.

wait_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for `ready`/`failed`. Defaults to 5,000 ms; capped at 60,000 ms (§10.5).

inputSchema.title: prepare_snapshot input

get_snapshot.description: Read a snapshot's current state. The `snapshot` argument is required; same shape as `prepare_snapshot` returns. On `live` returns a readiness-shaped answer (§8.7).

inputSchema.description: Input for `get_snapshot`. Reads the on-disk record and refreshes `last_access_unix` per §8.4.

snapshot.description: Snapshot id (`snap_` + 16 hex). Same shape as `prepare_snapshot` returns.

wait_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for a non-terminal state. Defaults to 5,000 ms; capped at 60,000 ms (§10.5).

inputSchema.title: get_snapshot input

list_contracts.description: Endpoints the federation exposes, filterable by service, repo, and kind (http/topic).

inputSchema.description: Input for `list_contracts`. Filters endpoints by service, repo, and kind; supports paging via `cursor`/`limit`.

kind.description: Filter by contract kind. Unknown values are rejected with `invalid_argument` rather than returning an empty page.

inputSchema.title: list_contracts input

get_contract.description: Providers, schema fields, and bound consumers for one endpoint (§12).

inputSchema.description: Input for `get_contract`. Returns providers, schema fields and bound consumers for one endpoint.

service.description: Optional service filter; without it every service providing `key` is returned.

inputSchema.title: get_contract input

list_unresolved.description: Every ambiguous and unresolved consumer with the candidate endpoints that could match (§9.7).

inputSchema.description: Input for `list_unresolved`. Lists every ambiguous and unresolved consumer with the candidate endpoints that could match it.
inputSchema.title: list_unresolved input

check_binding.description: Validate a proposed consumer→endpoint link and emit the YAML for `repos.yaml#bindings` (§12). Pure; creates nothing.

inputSchema.description: Input for `check_binding`. Validates a proposed consumer→endpoint link and emits its `bindings_entry` YAML for `repos.yaml`.
inputSchema.title: check_binding input

diff_contracts.description: Provider and consumer changes between two snapshots, classified, with impact paths and coverage (§12). `live` is not allowed as base/head.

inputSchema.description: Input for `diff_contracts`. Both `base` and `head` must be `ready` snapshots; `live` is not allowed.

head.description: Snapshot id (`snap_<hex>`); must be `ready`. `live` is invalid (`invalid_argument`, `live_not_supported`).

inputSchema.title: diff_contracts input

trace_impact.description: Impact paths from an endpoint, field, or symbol (§5.2 + §12). Exactly one of endpoint/field/symbol is required.

inputSchema.description: Input for `trace_impact`. Exactly one of endpoint/field/symbol is required.

from.description: Exactly one of `endpoint`, `field`, `symbol` must be set.

inputSchema.title: trace_impact input

get_coverage.description: What the view saw and what it could not resolve (§9.7). With an `endpoint`, `complete` reflects the could-match gate.

resolve_evidence.description: Check refs exist at their commit; return context. Bad refs are `exists: false` with a reason, never an error (§12).

inputSchema.description: Input for `resolve_evidence`.`refs` accepts GlobalIds or EvidenceRef texts (`<repo>@<sha>:<path>:<line>`).
inputSchema.title: resolve_evidence input

read_source.description: A bounded line range of a file at a view's commit (§10.7). Refuses secrets and binaries; reads snapshot content from the mirror's git2 blob.

inputSchema.description: Input for `read_source`. Reads a bounded line range from a file the view's index walked. The §10.7 safety rules apply.
inputSchema.title: read_source input
